metadata.description: Desire Study - CTRL_contentment condition (pleasant mood without desire)
metadata.purpose: Test whether generic good mood activates the desire vector (the analog of the pain study's sadness control)
metadata.matches: Numb control protocol, 100 sets per perspective
metadata.3P_gender_pattern: odd sets = male, even sets = female
